summary: (Re)allocates the three mesh buffers of a 3D buffer object from dimension fields this+0x15C/0x160/0x164/0x168 (vertex count, index count, batch count, sub-batch multiplier). Frees existing allocations at this+0x150/0x154/0x158 via FreeWrapper_7bcf, computes layout offsets, allocates a stream buffer (28 * batchCount), an index buffer (28 * indexCount), and a batch buffer (28 * batchCount * subBatchMultiplier) via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, then zero-fills all three in 28-byte records (nested batch loop strides by batchCount). Sets this+0x8 to 1 (allocated marker) and writes offset fields this+0xC/0x10/0x14.

operations.description: Free existing buffer pointers at this+0x150, this+0x154, this+0x158 with FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, before reallocation.

Compute layout offsets from dimension fields: this+0xC = vertexCount (this+0x15C) + 1; this+0x10 = that plus indexCount (this+0x160); this+0x14 = that plus batchCount (this+0x164); set allocated marker this+0x8 = 1.

Allocate three buffers with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and store them: stream buffer 28 * batchCount to this+0x154, index buffer 28 * indexCount to this+0x150, batch buffer 28 * batchCount * subBatchMultiplier (this+0x168) to this+0x158.
Zero-fill the stream buffer at this+0x150 in 28-byte records; guarded by batchCount (this+0x164) > 0.
Zero-fill the index buffer at this+0x154 in 28-byte records; guarded by indexCount (this+0x160) > 0.

Zero-fill the batch buffer at this+0x158 in a nested loop: for each of batchCount groups (guard this+0x164 > 0), subBatchMultiplier (this+0x168) records of 28 bytes are cleared at stride batchCount (this+0x164).
Return the loop-counter __int64 value seeded from unsigned batchCount (this+0x164) after the nested batch zero-fill completes.

clean_pseudocode: this->offsetA = v2; this->offsetB = v3; this->offsetC = this->batchCount + v3;
for (int k = 0; k < this->subBatchMultiplier; ++k) clear28(&this->batch[g + k * this->batchCount]);

The 28-byte record layout (7 _DWORD slots) is only inferred from the zero-fill stride; the record structure is not described by other evidence.

Assignment order of the three buffer pointers to this+0x150/0x154/0x158 differs between the source and the existing analysis; source order (this+0x154 then this+0x150 then this+0x158) is recorded here.
